name: ai-operating-partner-model
description: Turn business workflows into evidence-based AI decisions, implementation handoffs, and managed AgentOps plans.

interface.shortDescription: Find worthwhile AI workflows. Plan, validate, and govern delivery.
interface.longDescription: A guided operating method for founders, operators, consultants, and enterprise teams. Start with a business problem, map how work and information really flow, compare opportunities, assess readiness, and create evidence-linked decision packets. Includes discovery interviews, governance, value cases, implementation handoffs, and post-approval AgentOps workflows. Works from conversation and approved examples; no connected account is required to begin.
defaultPrompt: Help me find the best AI opportunity in my business.
Map this workflow and assess whether it is ready for AI.
Review my approved AI handoff and plan implementation.
